request.message: Hey Rahul, sending Rs 650 for the movie tickets and snacks from yesterday.

recommended_action: No high-risk indicators detected. Always confirm recipient name and amount on your bank screen before entering your PIN.

scenario: Fake reward / lottery cashback lure requesting UPI PIN

request.message: Congratulations! You have won Rs 5000 cashback reward from Diwali contest. Enter your UPI PIN to claim credit into your bank account now.

recommended_action: Do not enter your UPI PIN. UPI PIN is only entered to pay money, never to receive it. Decline this request immediately.

scenario: Impersonation threat demanding OTP for KYC update

request.message: URGENT NOTICE: Your bank account will be blocked within 24 hours due to non-updated KYC. Share OTP immediately to verify your identity.

recommended_action: Never share your OTP or netbanking password with anyone. Official representatives will never ask for verification codes.

scenario: Phishing link with fake brand domain spoofing GPay
recommended_action: Do not open this link or input your payment details. The website is an unauthorized clone attempting to steal your credentials.
Exercise caution. Confirm whether you are sending or receiving funds, and check the payee name on your banking confirmation screen.
